topic: Waiting weeks to file for unemployment vs filing the day you are laid off (Cedric vs Bernice)

scenes.narration: Unemployment benefits are not backdated in most states. Wait and lose them. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding a calendar with weeks crossed out and a check shrinking, comic burst banner reads NOT BACKDATED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cedric and Bernice are laid off from the same warehouse on Monday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man cedric and woman bernice leaving a warehouse with boxes, a sign reads LAYOFFS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both qualify for four hundred fifty dollars a week in benefits.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a benefits notice reading FOUR HUNDRED FIFTY WEEKLY, a state seal, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cedric feels embarrassed and decides to find a job first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man cedric sitting on a couch avoiding a laptop, a thought bubble reads I WILL FIND SOMETHING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Five weeks pass. Savings are gone. He finally applies.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man cedric at a laptop with an empty piggy bank, a calendar showing five crossed out weeks, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His claim starts the week he filed. Five weeks are lost forever.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a claim screen reading START DATE WEEK SIX, five weeks of checks fading away, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That is twenty two hundred fifty dollars he can never recover.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a pile of cash labeled TWENTY TWO FIFTY dissolving into smoke, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bernice files online Monday night, the same day she is let go.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bernice at a kitchen table filing online, a clock reads nine pm, a calendar reads MONDAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She uploads her separation letter and sets a weekly reminder.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bernice uploading a letter to a state site, a phone reminder reads CERTIFY WEEKLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her first payment lands in three weeks, backdated to Monday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a bank app showing a deposit labeled UNEMPLOYMENT, a note reads FROM WEEK ONE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cedric lost five weeks of pay. Bernice lost none.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man cedric with an empty wallet, woman bernice with a steady stack of weekly checks, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Laid off? File for benefits the same day. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a banner reading FILE THE SAME DAY, a laptop with a state seal, kids comic book illustration
